PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools.

2. When learning Driving Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Driving Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Driving Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Driving Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Driving Tools.

3. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety on Raised Platforms.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

5. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

7. When learning Self- Exploration and Career Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Self- Exploration and Career Development.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Self- Exploration and Career Development.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Self- Exploration and Career Development.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Self- Exploration and Career Development.

8. When learning Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

9. When learning Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

10. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Oblique Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Oblique Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Oblique Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Oblique Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Oblique Projection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Financial Services 4 5.2 Government and Busi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
